cc:Work.dc:title: Compact encrypted updates in the paper protocol
cc:Work.dc:description: CIFAR-10, ResNet-20, 30 clients, full participation, 128 clusters, 256-bit key. IID uses Dir(10); non-IID uses Dir(0.1). Accuracy changes are percentage points versus FedAvg; upstream ratios and seconds are lower-is-better. Source: https://arxiv.org/pdf/2406.09152v1#page=12
